images.seen: Plausible overall; Montana, Wyoming and Colorado drawn as US land far west of the Divide (Louisiana whole-state overshoot) and Poland shown as plain Russian land.
Mexico, Brazil, Bolivia, Peru, Western Australia and Kazakh occupation drawn sensibly; same US overshoot into the Oregon Country; grey Oregon Country is the dossiers' own convention.
Matches Cliopatria; Gran Colombia/Peru/Bolivia/Brazil plausible; Loreto plain Peru (the Maynas contest lost after the 1825 keyframe, patched); interior Suriname unclaimed.
Emirate of Nejd covers Najd with Riyadh inside; Hejaz as Habesh Eyalet; Eastern Province split among small states; plausible, nothing to fix.
Kokand drawn out to the Qing line as in Cliopatria (its 1822 extent under Madali Khan); Russian occupation hatching of the Kazakh Middle Zhuz; Bukhara/Kokand contest present; fine.
Far more detailed than Cliopatria and sensible: princely states as vassals, Burma/Assam/Bhutan fringe, Sikh Empire north-west; Afghan interior and Ladakh left as nobody.
Wrong: US purple pushed west of the Divide into Montana and a lobe of western Colorado, inside Mexican/Oregon land; Mexico correctly drawn to 42N. Patched.
Close-up: US lobe at 37-41N, 109-106.3W inside Mexico's strip, the Adams-Onis meridian is 106.33W; patched, and the stage render shows the straight line.

Good: French occupation just ended, Russian occupation of Moldavia and Wallachia hatched, Greece, Congress Poland; but Bessarabia hatched as Russian land occupied by the Ottomans and Kabarda as occupied by Circassia (both role-reversed). Patched.

Afghanistan fragmented into Kabul, Kandahar, Herat with a large nobody area in the Pashtun east and Baluchistan, and Peshawar left unowned after the Sikh 1828 keyframe; left, pages silent or no dossier.

issues.what: US shape overshoots into the Oregon Country: the Louisiana whole-state region keeps all of Montana (about 450 cells west of the Divide) in the US shape and every window keyframe re-adds it

US keeps about 330 cells of Colorado and south-western Wyoming west of 106 deg 20 min W that the Adams-Onis line left to Spain, then Mexico (a US lobe inside Mexico); Mexico's own keyframes drew only part of it
Bessarabia (Russian since 1812) drawn as Russian land occupied by the Ottoman Empire 1828-1833: ledger/71 over Moldavia and Wallachia also covers it and the compiler reversed the roles
Kabarda drawn as Russian land occupied by Circassia from 1822 (roles reversed); the page has it under Russian military rule from 1822

Maynas (Loreto, 659 cells) lost its contested status when the 1825 Peru keyframe added it as plain land; Gran Colombia's claim lasted to the Armistice of Piura (10 July 1829). Re-marked contested from 1826 (1825 end of year cannot carry it: keyframes snap after events)
Kokand wins 600 cells of Almaty, Naryn and Issyk-Kul over the Qing in 1822; the page says only that Kokand reached its greatest extent under Madali Khan (from 1822) and is silent on Zhetysu

Abdallab beats Muhammad Ali on the River Nile (491 cell-years 1820-21) and Taqali beats it in South Kordofan (242, 1822): the dossiers date Abdallab's submission to 1821 and keep Taqali de facto independent; the conquest page did not load, so not rechecked
Peshawar drawn Sikh-direct 1823-1827, then unowned 1828-1829 after the sikh-empire_1828 keyframe drops it (36 cells); the page has Peshawar tributary from 1823 and annexed only in 1834
Congress Poland was 46 specks in direct Russian land; the p1810-p1819 patch (events/3) hands it back and the trial shows Warsaw as congress-poland in the Russian tint through 1828
Gran Colombia and the United Provinces of Central America both claim the Mosquito Coast in 1823 (316 cells, one year); the Central American side wins
Durrani 1820 keyframe drops 1951 cells to nobody and the Emirate of Afghanistan 1828 keyframe adds 1213; Afghan interior, Baluchistan and Ladakh stay unowned in the draft
Remaining US/Mexico conflict of about 30 cells a year (Arkansas valley in south-east Colorado, Red River strip) goes to the US by the size rule

dossier_requests.what: The 'Louisiana' whole-state region (ledger/24, 1804, and the same union inside every keyframe correction from 1803 to 1845) overshoots: Montana, Wyoming and Colorado west of the Continental Divide are Oregon Country (joint US-British occupation 1818-1846), and Colorado/Wyoming west of 106 deg 20 min W and south of 42N is Spanish then Mexican. Cut both from the Louisiana region in the dossier; my patch only covers the 1820-1828 keyframes and the 1821 event.
dossier_requests.why: Without the fix the next window's keyframes (1830, 1834, 1836, 1840, 1842) re-add about 780 cells to the US.

dossier_requests.what: Peshawar (Barakzai sardars) was a Sikh tributary from 1823 to its annexation in 1834: a vassal dossier (or a 1828 keyframe including the Peshawar valley) is missing.
dossier_requests.why: The page says 'Peshawar became tributary in 1823' and was 'not formally annexed until 1834'; the draft has it Sikh-direct then unowned.

dossier_requests.what: ledger/2 (1822 occupation_start, counterpart russian-empire) means Russia occupying Kabarda but the compiler reads it as Circassia occupying Russian land; the patch closes it at once (events/2). Reword or drop it in the dossier.
dossier_requests.why: The page puts Kabarda under Russian military rule from 1822 and calls it 'property of the Russian government' from 1820.

problems: hierarchy: muhammad-ali-dynasty,ottoman-empire,1805,1819,vassal,3 stops at 1819 only 'because from 1820 the dynasty's land includes the Sudan conquest'; the page says Muhammad Ali acknowledged the Sultan's sovereignty, paid tribute ('subject only to a moderate annual tribute' after 1833, Convention of Kutahya), and only the 1840-41 Convention of London and firman of 13 Feb 1841 made it hereditary, khedive from 1867: extend the row to 1840 at least. Page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_Egypt_under_the_Muhammad_Ali_dynasty

hierarchy: kingdom-of-taqali,khedivate-of-egypt,1866,1883,vassal,2 starts in 1866, but its own evidence quotes the Taqali page for a 1821 vassal_start (Taqali 'would remain de facto independent', 'pay a nominal tax and be officially incorporated into Egyptian Sudan'); I did not open that page, so check whether the row should start 1821 under turco-egyptian-sudan

US keyframe overrides cover 1820, 1822, 1824, 1825 and 1828 only; the US keyframes of 1830, 1834, 1836, 1840 and 1842 (other windows) still carry the Louisiana overshoot (about 780 cells), and Mexico has no keyframe between 1826 and 1830 in this window, so later Mexican keyframes must keep Colorado and Wyoming west of 106 deg 20 min W (see dossier_requests)
events/3 (Peru contest over Loreto) starts in 1826 because a keyframe snap runs after the year's events; end of 1825 still shows Loreto uncontested

no patch entry reaches outside 1820-1829; the trial also applies the other windows' 358 entries and dossier edits made since 1 Nov, so conflict figures in the trial output differ from the packet for reasons beyond my patch (for example emirate-of-nejd / habesh-eyalet dropped out)

trial result: all 14 entries applied; US/Mexico conflict fell from 484 to 120 cell-years, new R2 successions first-mexican-empire/spanish-empire (330) and federated-republic-of-mexico/first-mexican-empire (239) are expected; the 4 entries were rendered from the stage and look right (Colorado, Bessarabia, Kabarda, Loreto)
